en.p: An arithmetic sequence $\{a_n\}$ whose first term equals its common difference and a geometric sequence $\{b_n\}$ satisfy the following condition.
holds, $a_2\times\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}b_{2n}=\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Given that $a_1\ne 0$, and $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
